path: vertical drop down the marker column; a closed U-shaped wall container catches the drop when the marker column lies within its horizontal footprint, otherwise the path reaches the bottom edge
dst: closed U-shaped container interior, or the bottom row if no closed container catches the drop
trajectory: fill the caught container's background interior with the marker color; if uncaught, fill the whole bottom row
transform: erase the original marker pixel and keep all wall pixels unchanged
